name: sql-console
title: SqlConsole
description: A SQL workbench for a PGlite database, made of parts: a header with the versions and a Database menu (SQL / data-directory export and import), a sidebar with the schema (a Tree over schemaTreeItems) and the history, the console's SqlEditor (a highlighted textarea on UI SDK's Textarea: ⌘/Ctrl+Enter runs, ↑/↓ history, an error squiggle, a footer part) and a DataTable per statement with typed headers, type-aware cells and CSV / JSON copy, or the error with its line, caret, SQLSTATE and hint.
